name: Rocsys
sub: Charging & energy (depot / robotic); Cleaning, maintenance & inspection
about: Robotic charging company focused on automating depot charging for robotaxis and electric fleets; their multi-bay robotaxi charging system is a central Layer F node.
model: Robotic charging hardware, software, service contracts
deployment: Pilot deployment of multi-bay robotic robotaxi charging; large-scale rollout planned for 2027 with unnamed robotaxi operator
metrics: System can manage up to 10 robotaxis at once per 2026 report

sources.title: Rocsys unveils multi-bay hands-free robotaxi charging system, raises $13M
